title: isomorphism
description: A morphism with a two-sided inverse (g ∘ f = id_A, f ∘ g = id_B) — the categorical notion of 'same structure, possibly different presentation.' Objects connected by one are interchangeable. A morphism refined by invertibility.

inverse.description: a morphism g : B → A with g ∘ f = id_A and f ∘ g = id_B
